source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current folder row drop-target shares the selected.current focused palette, even when the tree itself lacks focus. A selected row alone uses a different palette. Preserve drop-target as a distinct semantic class rather than treating it as a synonym for selected. These state class names are part of the existing folder-list contract. No real drag, high-contrast or keyboard run was made.
title: Keep drop target, current row and selected row as distinct states
